_what: PERSONA LAUNCH GO-LIVE (A-WEB-PROXY-HOP-HEADERS): the request headers Railway's edge adds to every request it forwards to a service, as Railway DOCUMENTS them. DOCUMENTED, NOT RECORDED: no request was captured from a real deployment (no network call is made by any test). The values are dummies (RFC 5737 / RFC 2606 addresses and names). validator/test/anonweb.test.js replays this set on /zk/anon/web and /zk/anon/web/head (accepted only with TRUST_PROXY=true) and on the rate limiter; scripts/smoke-deployed.mjs check 10 re-checks the REAL edge on the first deploy and every deploy after it.

observed_not_documented._why: not on Railway's specs page, but present on Railway-forwarded requests per Railway's own staff answers (station.railway.com); tolerated by the same x-forwarded- prefix

not_added_by_railway._why: headers this set deliberately does NOT contain: Railway documents no Cloudflare (cf-*) header, and X-Railway-Debug is a header a CLIENT sends (it asks for debug response headers). PUBLIC GO-LIVE: validator/anon.js refuses x-railway-debug outright (WEB_REFUSED_HEADERS), although the x-railway- hop prefix covers its spelling; validator/test/anonweb.test.js replays every name below beside the documented set and expects a refusal (re-read on the source page 2026-10-17: the six documented names above, no X-Forwarded-For, X-Railway-Debug as the only client-sent header)
